tools.name: zen_open_or_focus_url

tools.description: Open an http(s) URL in Zen or focus an already-open matching tab. Non-destructive.

ai.instructions: Use Zen tools to inspect and control Zen Browser through local Mozeidon commands. Prefer active page context for summarization, selection-or-page context for selected text, and tab search/list tools for open tab questions. Do not claim content is available when a tool returns a content_unavailable error.
